title: Default Value Reference
content:
Every variable in Papyrus starts with a default value, based on its type. The default values for each type are listed below:

{| class="wikitable"
! Type
! Default Value
|-
| Bool
| False
|-
| Int
| 0
|-
| Float
| 0.0
|-
| String
| ""
|-
| Objects
| None
|-
| Arrays
| None
|-
| Structs
| None
|-
| Var
| None
|}
